headline: Crude bomb explodes in front of old Ramna Police Station
summary: Two individuals on a motorcycle threw an improvised explosive device before fleeing the scene on Friday evening.
details: A crude bomb exploded in front of the old Ramna Police Station on Bailey Road in Dhaka around 8pm on Friday.
According to Sheikh Jahidul Islam, deputy commissioner of the police's Ramna Division, the blast was caused by an improvised explosive device.
Police report that two people on a motorcycle arrived at the spot, threw the device and quickly drove away.
Authorities are currently examining CCTV footage from the area to identify and track down those involved in the attack.

headline_marked: £15M flat in London [[frozen by UK High Court]] for former Land Minister's brother
headline: £15M flat in London frozen by UK High Court for former Land Minister's brother
summary: The property, linked to Anisuzzaman Chowdhury, is under investigation by the National Crime Agency for suspected money laundering.
details: The UK High Court has banned the sale or transfer of a £15 million flat near Regent's Park in London. The order comes as part of an investigation into the financial dealings of an influential Bangladeshi family.
caption:
A £15 million London flat linked to the brother of Bangladesh's former Land Minister has been frozen by the UK High Court.
